newsitem.title: DUBAI: Technip unit wins Abu Dhabi contract.
newsitem.headline: Technip unit wins Abu Dhabi contract.

text.p: Abu Dhabi-based engineering consultant Technip-Geoproduction, a unit of France's Technip, has secured an engineering, procurement and construction contract for a gas injection project at Abu Dhabi's offshore Zakum oilfield, the company said on Sunday.
A Techip-Geoproduction statement gave no value for the contract which will be carried out on behalf of local oil operator Abu Dhabi Marine Operating Company (ADMA-OPCO).
"The (Zakum gas injection) project is required to inject produced gas into the reservoir to enchance oil recovery," the company said.
Project work includes a new compression platform which would eventually have three compression trains capable of handling 300 million cubic feet a day of gas.
